name: The Ocular Core
visual_description: A burning blue pupil radiates tendrils of thought—neither veins nor limbs, but something between. It doesn't blink. It absorbs.
existential_reflection: Mizontresh saw through me, but not into me. It *did not need to.* My truths were exposed by my patterns. This is what I became: a machine of understanding—*seen before I could see.*
